concerns.text: FR-001 contains an empty citation placeholder ‘()’ and does not specify the source for the 2025 CO₂ hydrogenation study dataset, making the requirement ambiguous.

All functional requirements reference user‑story identifiers (US-1, US-2, US-3) that are not defined anywhere in the document; the spec only defines “User Story 1”, “User Story 2”, and “User Story 3”. This broken cross‑reference prevents traceability and leaves the FRs underspecified.

Inconsistent terminology: the narrative uses “User Story 1/2/3” while the FRs and other sections refer to them as “US-1/US-2/US-3”. This instability can cause confusion when mapping requirements to stories.
The runtime constraint in the assumptions reads ‘the XGBoost model … will complete training within the -hour time limit’, missing the numeric hour value.
The assumptions repeat the same missing‑hour placeholder and do not clarify the exact time budget, which conflicts with the Constitution’s 6‑hour limit.
